title: ‘I just don’t know the rules anymore’: Nvidia and Jensen Huang’s mockery of modern HR
summary: The scandal-ridden executive's shocking return is antithetical to everything practitioners tell themselves about how organizations should function and how leaders should behave.

title: Employers expect new hires to have a ‘willingness to learn’
summary: While a growing number of organizations want to upskill existing employees, more than a third say they’re looking for employees with “expertise in new areas.”

title: Collective action rights under FLSA are not waivable without an arbitration agreement, judge rules
summary: The plaintiff’s lawyer called the order “an important decision for every worker who has been handed paperwork and told to sign away their rights before they can get a job.”

title: We owe Cardi B — and all working mothers — an apology
summary: In light of Cardi B’s 2027 Grammy Awards nomination, HR Dive reporter Caroline Colvin revisits decade-old claims the rapper would never be successful as a working mother.

title: Former Uber worker alleges disability bias after termination following work-from-home accommodation
summary: The worker was fired a couple weeks into her new arrangement, but Uber relied on her not following a policy she’d never been trained on, she said.

title: Many companies use AI, but few pair it with culture changes, report says
summary: CHROs who emphasize the connection between culture and artificial intelligence tool use were “twice as likely to sustain superior market performance,” per a new report.

title: Dishonesty and unprotected absences, not FMLA use, caused CSX to fire workers, court rules
summary: One worker had taken leave on Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Superbowl Sunday, Valentine’s Day and Easter Sunday — despite previous warnings.

title: Court blocks DHS policy limiting international student training opportunities
summary: The higher education groups suing to strike down new limits on the Curricular Practical Training program are likely to succeed, a federal judge ruled.

title: Training is key to AI adoption — but is still hitting roadblocks
summary: Unbalanced access to artificial intelligence tool training may limit broader uptake and stifle company transformation, some studies show.

title: Fox TV fired news host with facial disability because viewers mocked her appearance, lawsuit alleges
summary: The station’s news director allegedly believed the online comments would hurt the station and his career, according to the complaint.
